text_block_list.text: One day, shortly before running in her debut race.
In order to make preparations, I visited the grounds ahead of Grass Wonder, and—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew... Right, then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep, warm-up complete♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well then—shall we get going?!

Kicking off the ground with effortless grace
was Maruzensky, the Umamusume of many titles.

"Having seen her name countless times on TV, in magazines,
and in online articles, her running truly comes down to
one word――'overwhelming.'"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this feels so good—!

"Her running style is labeled as 'Front Runner' for convenience,
but she herself likely has no awareness of 'running away.'"

From start to finish, no one can get ahead of her.
It's simply that she is 'too fast'...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Not yet... I'm gonna fly!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Truly a 'Monster.'
A terrifying sprint worthy of the name."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just a moment ago.
Preparations are complete, we can begin anytime~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...There is no time to look up and be captivated.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let us quietly and solemnly hone our craft.

“Grass Wonder burns with an unyielding fighting spirit,
undaunted even by the ‘Monster.’”
Reaffirming my resolve to do everything I can to help her reach the pinnacle, I carried on with our training that day...
And then, one day.
Entering a certain mock race with fellow Umamusume who debuted in the same class, Grass Wonder—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wawa... G-Grass-chan,
what incredible acceleration...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uhyaa, so scary, so scary.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When Grass-chan gets that "I've got you!" look on her face,
she's seriously the absolute last person you'd ever want to face~

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Well, that only fires me up even more, though!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...El's pretty much a total masochist, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Under 200 meters to go!
Grass-chan is in the lead...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!!

Grass Wonder pulled away from the pack
just like that and crossed the finish line in 1st place!

1600m on turf, with a time of 1 minute 34 seconds...
An incredible result—unbelievable for a Junior-tier Umamusume!

Even the press who came to cover the mock race
were buzzing with excitement over Grass Wonder's spectacular run.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Magnificent...!!
If I remember correctly, that girl's name is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply delighted that you enjoyed
the mock race featuring our up-and-coming Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Symboli Rudolf-san!
Man, we got so many great shots!!
Especially that last girl...!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Do you also believe, Symboli Rudolf-san,
that this generation has an unusually high number of standouts?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Of course, every Umamusume
has a promising future, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take El Condor Pasa, for example.
Proudly proclaiming herself the "World's Strongest" and constantly striving to live up to that title makes her truly captivating.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take Seiun Sky, for example.
She keeps a low profile normally, but once on the turf, she's a master trickster who uses every trick up her sleeve to seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take Special Week, for example.
Though she often seems bewildered by her new environment, there's a brilliance in her late-stage burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see!
Those are all names we've been seeing a lot of lately, aren't they~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
And, for example—Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah! That Umamusume from earlier, right?! Yes, yes, speaking of her...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Asahi Hai FS, it's a 1600m turf race,
and she clocked a fantastic 1:34! This is—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "How could you not be remindedof the legend of the "Monster" Maruzensky!?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Indeed, by coincidence it resulted in
the exact same record time set by Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! So basically!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So Grass Wonder is the successor to Maruzensky...
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call her
the "Second-Generation Monster"!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-cha~n!! Great work!!
That time was incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ......Grass-chan?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ho... "The Second Monster," is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Seeing her run today, I'm sure many in the press felt the exact same way!
I believe everyone will start calling her that soon with great anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: When it comes to Maruzensky-san, just hearing her name brings countless legends to mind—she really is an overwhelming Umamusume~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Strictly between us, I'm also just an Umamusume fan who was captivated by that legendary "Supercar"!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ever-victorious and undefeated, with a cumulative marginof 61 lengths over second place in just 8 races since her debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Her run, truly worthy of being called a "solo journey," struck immense awe into the other horse girls...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Eventually, just having her name on the entry list was enough to make other Umamusume withdraw one after another.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! There were so few participants once
that the race almost had to be canceled entirely!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course a void race would be a problem...
However, the fact that every single race had under 10 runners
is truly worthy of being called legendary!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hence why they were called a "monster," but...
that's where Grass Wonder-san comes in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: She, too, has such incredible talent before even debuting... no, before even being scouted!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, she was calm enough to call it effortless!
A victory demonstrating a ruthless gap in strength!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"This is truly Maruzensky-class!
I believe she's thoroughly worthy of the title 'Monster II'!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Just as you gave as an example,
I have high expectations for Grass Wonder as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, are you heading back to the dorms after this?
If you'd like, maybe we could—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No... I'm sorry, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of dropping by the gym~,
so I'll be taking my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What!?
The gym, right now!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "She marches toward the pinnacle with an unyielding resolve, and that is precisely why I hold such high expectations for her."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ..."The Monster II."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Given Senpai's ability, it's a name I should be honored by.
And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "The Second" is not a title for the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot afford to be happy.
